entries.body: With this mod, you can control Redstone Links, just like the typewriter or Tweaked Controller. Below you will see the dedicated sub-menu for adding these frequencies. It works exactly the same as other Create add-ons, so I won't take the time to add tooltips to this image:

As you can see above, there are up to 20 configurable frequencies, internally called L1 - L20 

 You can also receive redstone signals in the Sequencer mode, if you set up that receiving frequency here.
